'''Darth Xarion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who sat on the [[Dark Council]] by [[3628 BBY]].

==Biography==
Xarion was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Onslaught" /> [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] alive around [[3643 BBY]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he began a battle with a rival Sith Lord [[Darth Anathel|Anathel]] in the [[Stygian Caldera]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]. Their conflict started disrupting Imperial trade, prompting a negotiator to convince them to move their battle elsewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Blind Hatred" />

He would later rise to the position of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] and sit on the [[Dark Council]] by [[3628 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TOR updates|5.10.0}}</ref> as leader of the newly-created [[Sphere of Galactic Influence|Galactic Influence]]. In this position, Darth Xarion oversaw [[Sith Intelligence]] and the former [[Sphere of Expansion and Diplomacy]]. His rival Darth Anathel would also be on the Council as Head of [[Sphere of Sith Doctrine|Sith Doctrine]].<ref name="State of the Galaxy" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Xarion_on_Elom.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Darth Xarion and other Sith restraining Malgus on Elom.]]
In Update 5.10 ''Jedi Under Siege'', Darth Xarion is indirectly mentioned by [[NR-02]] as the latter's master, who is unable to speak with the player at the time. Darth Xarion makes his first live appearance in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'' as a Dark Councillor. For Republic players who are saboteurs for the Empire, Darth Xarion's identity is revealed and confers with the player over [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] in the [[Slippery Slopes Cantina]].

For Imperial players, after [[Darth Malgus]] is defeated on [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], Xarion will arrive to help restrain him with the Force and arrest him.<ref name="Ruins of Nul">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=flashpoint|Ruins of Nul}}</ref>
